title: Advanced English I
description: First course in the state's 4-credit English sequence. Covers literary analysis, composition, grammar/language conventions, and research skills at an accelerated pace.

title: Advanced Geometry
description: Assumes Algebra I was completed in 8th grade via MISD's accelerated middle-school math path (config: algebraICompletedGrade8). Covers logical reasoning/proof, congruence, similarity, coordinate geometry, circles, and 3D measurement.

title: Advanced Biology
description: First course in the state's 4-credit science sequence. Covers cell structure/function, genetics, evolution, ecology, and biological processes with a lab component.

title: World Geography (Advanced)
description: Survey of physical and human geography, satisfying the first credit of the state's 3-credit Social Studies sequence.

title: Theatre Arts I (Advanced)
description: Satisfies the state's 1-credit Fine Arts requirement. ECHS-only course (not TCC campus dual credit — TCC coursework begins in grade 10 per config.tccStartGrade).

title: Spanish I (Advanced)
description: First year of the same-language Languages Other Than English sequence (config.lotePlan = Spanish).

title: Foundations of Personal Fitness
description: Satisfies the state's 1-credit Physical Education requirement. Covers fitness principles, goal-setting, and lifetime wellness habits.

title: AVID 1 + College Readiness Seminar
description: AVID instructional strategies and mentorship, introducing organizational systems, Cornell note-taking, and a college-going mindset for the ECHS cohort.
